summary: Added Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) implementing the W3C CBD rules 1-3 via a nested add_to_cbd helper, with a docstring in Graph style. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering rule 1/2 counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank node in reifier not expanded, blank-node cycle, and source-graph immutability. Tests were not run (per instructions); verification was by reading only. Expected counts are hand-computed from my own fixture, not the reference fixture. No commits made.
